newsitem.title: USA: Monterey Pasta names Hewitt CEO.
newsitem.headline: Monterey Pasta names Hewitt CEO.

text.p: Monterey Pasta Co Wednesday said it has named Lance Hewitt, the company's current president and chief operating officer, to the additional position of chief executive officer.
He will replace Kenneth Steel, effective August 1. Steel will remain a director and a member of the audit committee.

"The return to profitability marks the successful completion of the company's most recent turnaround plan," Steel said in a statement. "Lance Hewitt's primary charter will be to enhance shareholder value through execution of profitable growth in future periods."
In addition to naming Hewitt CEO, Monterey Pasta also boosted its sales agreement with Sam's Club, a division of Wal-Mart Stores Inc.
Monterey Pasta has received commitments to supply an average of 10 additional products to up to 75 more stores in regional division in Atlanta, Chicago, Dallas and Seattle.
Monterey Pasta currently supplies an average of 11 different products to 100 Sam's Club stores in five regional divisions in Atlanta, Bentonville, Dallas, Los Angeles and Phoenix.
